auth.createAccountSubtitle: You'll manage your players and registrations from here.

consent.title: Parental consent
consent.intro: Because Global Stage is used by players under 18, we need your consent as a parent or legal guardian before creating any player profiles.
consent.bullet1: We collect only the information needed to register your player for events.
consent.bullet2: We never show advertising to players and never sell family data.
consent.bullet3: You can review, edit, or delete your family's data at any time.
consent.acceptParental: I am the parent/legal guardian and I consent to the creation of a player profile for my child, in accordance with COPPA (USA) and PIPEDA (Canada).
consent.acceptPrivacy: I have read and accept the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

help.title: Help & FAQ
help.faq1Q: How does the deposit and installment plan work?
help.faq1A: You pay a deposit to reserve your player's spot, then the remaining balance is split into scheduled payments shown in My Tournaments.
help.faq2A: We collect only what's needed to register your player and never show ads to players, in line with COPPA and PIPEDA.
help.faq3Q: Can I register a player for a team?
help.faq3A: Team and club registration is coming in a future update. Today, Global Stage supports individual player registration.
